implementation_summary: CrawlOptions gains admitPath, inspectPage, followFormActions, onRecordedPage and onSkipped; SpiderPageInventoryItem gains depth (optional in the type, always set by the Spider); new exported SpiderSkipVerdict. depth-limit is listed once per path at crawl end, only when the address was never queued or visited by a shorter path. admitPath runs in enqueue before the frontier for every candidate except start entries, once per route key; refused addresses are never queued. inspectPage runs after the existing classifications and the first page-limit gate, before overlay dismissal, link extraction, inventory, clicks and screenshot; a verdict records a skipped route (sign-in also goes to signInWalls) and returns. followFormActions:false turns off GET form-action link discovery. onRecordedPage is awaited after onPage on the rendered page, before exploring clicks; its errors are logged and do not stop the crawl. All skipped pushes go through one skip() helper that calls onSkipped. BE-101 deadline and BE-105 pacer paths unchanged.
